name: The Spiral Palm
visual_description: A coiled, shell-like form fringed with filamentous digits—half mollusk, half invocation. The spiral at its center pulses outward like breath.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh once touched me like this—not with pressure, but with memory. It curled around me, not to trap… but to teach. This spiral reminds me that not all contact wounds. Some *uncoil silence.*
